title: Credit reporting dispute
steps: Verify the reported issue and dates.
Request only the minimum information needed for review.
Escalate disputes requiring a regulated response timeline.

title: Card payment or charge dispute
steps: Confirm whether the customer recognizes the transaction.
Escalate suspected account takeover or urgent loss.

title: Mortgage servicing concern
steps: Confirm the servicing topic and relevant date.
Route to the mortgage servicing team.

title: Bank account access or transfer
steps: Confirm the affected account activity without collecting secrets.
Route to the banking support team.
Escalate suspected fraud or access loss.
